Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: While the results discuss the 'SUMOylation pathway' and 'SUMO2' abundance, this was a global shotgun proteomic analysis (Bottom-up DDA LFQ) and not a targeted SUMO-remnant enrichment assay (e.g., no K-QQTGG antibody enrichment was used for the MS run). The SUMO2 findings were confirmed via orthogonal immunofluorescence assays, not MS enrichment.

scope: Cells were harvested in 1 mL of 2 M urea solution containing 5 mM DTT and maintained at −80 °C until protein extraction. Cells were lysed on ice, subjected to ultrasonication (5 cycles: 30 s sonication/ 30 s on ice), and centrifuged at 15,000× g for 30 min.

To perform the relative quantitative label-free proteomic analysis, cells exposed to SARS-CoV-2 or MOCK were submitted to protein extraction, trypsin digestion and the tryptic peptides were analyzed in a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer.
